newsitem.title: UK: Brooke gains on results, director buying.
newsitem.headline: Brooke gains on results, director buying.

text.p: Shares in Brooke Industrial Holdings Plc, a maker of industrial cutting tools and springs, rose on Thursday as the company announced a sharp rise in profits and two of its directors bought lines of stock.
Brooke shares were up 16-1/2p at 140 by 1422 GMT in volume of 21,900 shares.
The company said Chris Boddington, a non-executive director, bought 4,000 shares at 130p and finance director Paul Gill bought 1,000 at the same price.
Earlier, Brooke posted a 129 percent rise in first-half pre-tax profit to 0.70 million stg, on turnover up 43 percent at 15.18 million stg. The dividend was raised 50 percent to 1.5p per share.

The company said it had successfully integrated recent acquisitions. It said it would continue to explore opportunities to expand, both organically and through acquisition, while "being mindful of its objective of improving shareholder value".
